description.value: You have a reinforced chassis to protect your frame from harm without interfering with your movements or increasing your size. During your daily preparations, you can apply a specially formulated coating and additional reinforcement to your outer chassis. This coating grants you Hardness equal to half your level rounded up. The first time each day you're damaged by a critical hit or reduced to half your Hit Points or less, this coating wears off, and you lose the Hardness granted by this feat until your next daily preparations.
